selection: complete original inner OOF RMSE; original selection_key
base_policy: reuse previously nested-tuned archived caches exactly; no new base fitting
outer_prediction: equal-weight four original inner base models, each corrected on its disjoint heldout calibration fold; never refit the paired base
inner_prediction: for each original inner validation fold, average deep base/calibration pairs contained entirely in inner training; evaluate only original inner heldout
controls: paired ensemble with zero correction; original five-model archived OOF unchanged
centering: original calibration mean-zero centered corrector; no new intercept
limits: original features, grids, amplitudes and frozen splits; no regional rules, no extra depth
scope: exploratory structural contrast, not independent confirmation or pure isolation: training sizes and calibration support also change
